propositions: The S3 recovery operation must be invoked exactly once at the validated write boundary in reconcile.py, positioned after the under-lock staleness gate and scoped_ids computation but before the first remote issue fetch.

Read-only commands and filtered paths must perform zero writes from the recovery operation; the guard refuses invocation when persist is false or scoped is true and returns an empty outcome without classification or repository interaction.
A durable tombstone created by completion must remain authoritative until explicit unretire; automatic confirmations with same-key, absence clearing, or 200-status responses cannot revoke it.
Completion failure must preserve the overlap as recoverable evidence and structurally perform zero remote calls, because the call precedes the fetch.
